To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the effectiveness of e-commerce website design is a function of how well the design enables the customer to achieve high levels and quality of information foraging, the effectiveness of e- commerce website design can be measured in terms of website efficiency, and the business value impact of e-commerce website efficiency can be measured and validated in terms of customer transaction productivity.
the effectiveness of e-commerce website design can be conceptualized in terms of the efficiency with which the website supports the customer's purchase decision making.

the design of an e commerce website is a key determinant of the business value of the website and that the design of a website should be evaluated using a full cycle methodology that measures the efficiency of the website in terms of its ability to transform inputs (e.g., customer actions) to outputs (e.g., purchase transactions).
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and evaluation of e commerce websites.
the design of e commerce website and how it affects customer value and firm performance.
the measurement of e commerce website efficiency and the business impact of e commerce websites.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the design of e commerce websites is a significant factor in the value that is created for both customers and the businesses that provide e commerce services.
effective e commerce website design is indeed an effective means of value creation for e commerce retailers.
the effectiveness of e-commerce website design can be measured in terms of the efficiency with which the design supports the consumer's information foraging activities.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have provided the theoretical and methodological foundation for understanding the efficacy and business value of e commerce website designs.
the proposed framework and the measurement approach can provide a basis for understanding how website design can impact customer value.

we have developed and tested a methodology for evaluating the effectiveness of e-commerce websites, and have found that effective websites lead to business value in the form of increased customer value.
The main takeaway from our work is that
website design does have a measurable and significant impact on the value of the business.

the design and evaluation of e commerce systems can be approached from the point of view of production economics and that this approach is a useful and effective tool for the design and evaluation process.
website efficiency is a key determinant of customer value and business value.
